title: Committee of Supply – Head M (Ministry of Finance)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply – Head M (Ministry of Finance)

sections.label: MOF fiscal policy role
sections.summary: MOF manages fiscal policies and ensures prudent, efficient whole-of-Government resource allocation amid constrained finances and rising spending needs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: As the key Ministry responsible for managing fiscal policies and financial sustainability, MOF plays a pivotal role to ensure prudent and efficient allocation of resources across the whole-of-Government.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: During this period where our fiscal situation is a lot more constrained and yet our spending needs continue to rise sharply, we need to be even more judicious in managing how we spend and whether we achieve the intended outcomes.

sections.label: Jobs Support Scheme cost
sections.summary: The Jobs Support Scheme was the most significant cost item in Government COVID-19 expenditure.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
sentences.text: The Jobs Support Scheme (JSS) was by far the most significant cost item in the Government’s expenditure to fight COVID-19.

sections.label: JSS targeting questions
sections.summary: As COVID-19 impacted industries unevenly, questions arose on whether JSS could have been more targeted from the beginning.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
sentences.text: With COVID-19 pandemic impacting industries and companies unevenly, questions have arisen on whether JSS could have been more targeted from the beginning, channelling differentiated and sustained help to impacted sectors and none to firms that are positively impacted.

sections.label: Fiscal councils described
sections.summary: Fiscal councils are agencies staffed by professional civil servants that evaluate policy proposals to provide budgetary implications.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Chairman, fiscal councils are agencies staffed by professional civil servants which evaluate policy proposals to provide budgetary implications.

sections.label: Independent fiscal council proposal
sections.summary: An independent fiscal council is proposed, with MOF to consider a Parliamentary Budget Office of Singapore seeded with $20 million to score major policy proposals.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Moreover, an independent fiscal council can be especially useful at this juncture in our economic evolution, given how we are currently running the largest Budget deficit since Independence, with substantial uncertainty over the likely future evolution of our economy.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Unlike the past where our Government has run balanced Budgets over successive terms and, hence, we may have had little need for this institution, there was an unprecedented deficit over the last term of Government which necessitated a draw on past reserves.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: I propose that the MOF consider the formation of an independent fiscal council, the Parliamentary Budget Office of Singapore seeded with an initial $20 million and tasked with the mandate to score all major policy proposals, formally advanced by Members of Parliament for budgetary and macro implications.

sections.label: RIE 2025 Plan investments
sections.summary: The Research Innovation and Enterprise RIE 2025 Plan announced in December 2020 plans $25 billion in investments between 2021 and 2025.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The Research Innovation and Enterprise RIE 2025 Plan announced in December 2020 plans for investments of $25 billion between 2021 and 2025.

sections.label: Temasek hurdle rate and TSR
sections.summary: Temasek sets its own hurdle rate at a risk adjusted cost of capital that its market value TSR has under-performed on several periods as of March 2020.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: As I understand it, Temasek also sets its own hurdle rate at a risk adjusted cost of capital that its market value TSR has under-performed on the one, three, 10 and 20-year periods, as of March 2020.

sections.label: Reserves draw-down financing principle
sections.summary: The speaker asks whether reserves draw-down first uses cash or cash equivalents held by MAS or other institutions, and asks the Government for the operating principle.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Or is the first line of execution for reserves draw-down utilising cash or cash equivalents held by the MAS or other institutions?

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Hence, I would like to use this cut to ask the Government what is the operating principle that determines how reserves draw-downs are financed and executed with these considerations and questions in mind?

sections.label: Organic waste conveyance and digester
sections.summary: An example is designing upstream and investing in an organic waste conveyance system cum digester as part of a building or district.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: For example, designing upstream and investing in an organic waste conveyance system cum digester as part of building or district.

sections.label: Scheme needs Government support
sections.summary: The scheme was off to a good start but will need Government's support to boost its usage.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har
sentences.text: The scheme was off to a good start, but it will need Government’s support to give it a boost in usage.

sections.label: New COVID-19 support schemes
sections.summary: New schemes were quickly introduced to address needs, including the COVID-19 Support Grant, Jobs Support Scheme and Temporary Bridging Loan Programmes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat (Bishan-Toa Payoh)
sentences.text: In response, a number of new schemes were very quickly introduced to address their needs, including the COVID-19 Support Grant, Jobs Support Scheme, Temporary Bridging Loan Programmes and many more.

sections.label: Sustainability and gender diversity reporting
sections.summary: The question asks whether the Ministry can require larger private companies to report sustainability and gender diversity efforts in annual returns.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
sentences.text: Can the Ministry consider making it a requirement for larger private companies to report on their sustainability and gender diversity efforts in their annual returns?

sections.label: Temasek emissions targets scopes
sections.summary: Temasek committed to halve 2010 net portfolio emissions by 2030 and reach net zero by 2050, covering only scopes 1 and 2 emissions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: First, it is good that Temasek has committed to half 2010 net portfolio emissions by 2030 and to deliver net zero by 2050, But this refers to only scopes 1 and 2 emissions.

sections.label: Housing aspirations of younger residents
sections.summary: HDB's latest sample household survey found 73% of residents aged 35 and below aspire to upgrade their housing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Aspirations for better housing is particularly pertinent for residents aged 35 and below, with 73% aspiring to upgrade according to the HDB's latest sample household survey.

sections.label: ABSD upfront payment for HDB owners
sections.summary: An HDB owner who has not sold their current home must pay 12% ABSD upfront within 14 days of signing the S&P agreement for private property.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: An HDB owner today has to pay 12% ABSD upfront within 14 days of signing the S&P agreement for a private property if he or she has not already sold their current home.

sections.label: Semi-automatic ABSD remission six months
sections.summary: The Government grants semi-automatic ABSD remission giving owners six months after collecting the keys to sell the flat.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: The Government grants semi-automatic ABSD remission providing them six months after collecting the keys to sell the flat.

sections.label: MOF public sector capabilities question
sections.summary: The question asks what MOF has done to build public sector capabilities in procurement, grants management, internal audit and shared services.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jessica Tan Soon Neo (East Coast)
sentences.text: Can Minister share what MOF has done to build up public sector capabilities in areas of procurement, grants management, internal audit and shared services to enable better governance, value for money and benefits for the businesses and citizens?

sections.label: MOF redirected $8 billion funding
sections.summary: In the October Ministerial Statement, DPM Heng highlighted MOF re-directed about $8 billion from reduced-spending areas like COVID-19-delayed projects to fighting COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: As an example, in the October Ministerial Statement, Deputy Prime Minister Heng highlighted that MOF had re-directed funding of about $8 billion from areas with reduced spending, such as development projects that were delayed due to COVID-19, towards funding our fight towards COVID-19.

sections.label: Biomedical sector in Singapore
sections.summary: The biomedical sector makes up about 4% of Singapore's GDP, and four of the world's top 10 drugs by global revenue are made in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: As Deputy Prime Minister mentioned just now in his Round-Up speech, the biomedical sector in Singapore today makes up about 4% of our GDP, and four of the world's top 10 drugs by global revenue are made in Singapore.

sections.label: RSEs and business R&D spending
sections.summary: Industry RSEs tripled from about 6,500 to over 19,000 between 1998 and 2018, while Business Expenditure on R&D rose from $1.5 billion to about $5.6 billion.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Industry RSEs has tripled from about 6,500 to over 19,000, in the 20 years from 1998 to 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: In the same period of time, Business Expenditure on R&D has increased by more than two-and-a-half times, from $1.5 billion in 1998 to approximately $5.6 billion in 2018.

sections.label: Design improvements and capital savings
sections.summary: Over the past five years, these processes led to design improvements and generated savings of about $4 billion, or about 5% of capital costs.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Over the past five years, these processes have led to design improvements and generated savings of about $4 billion in total or about 5% of the capital costs.

sections.label: Agency for Care Effectiveness savings
sections.summary: MOH's Agency for Care Effectiveness evaluates clinical-effectiveness and cost-effectiveness of medicines, vaccines and medical technologies and negotiates fair prices, delivering $300 million in savings between 2016 and 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: For example, MOH's Agency for Care Effectiveness evaluates the clinical-effectiveness and cost-effectiveness of medicines, vaccines and medical technologies and then negotiates fair prices with companies.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: This has delivered total cost savings of $300 million between 2016 and 2020.

sections.label: Life-cycle cost savings approach
sections.summary: This approach avoids projects that are cheaper to build but expensive to maintain, and is expected to bring savings of 2% to 5% in total life-cycle costs.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: In this way, we avoid having projects, be it buildings or infrastructure, that may be cheaper to build but are expensive to maintain and operate and, in fact, on an overall basis, end up being more expensive.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: And so, by taking this approach, we expect to bring about savings of 2% to 5% in total life-cycle costs over the long-term, which is a significant sum given that we spend about $15 billion to $20 billion every year on capital expenditure alone.

sections.label: Jobs Support Scheme and loans
sections.summary: Preliminary data suggests the Jobs Support Scheme reduced job losses in vulnerable firms, while loan schemes supported over 20,000 firms in accessing loans.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Preliminary data suggests that the Jobs Support Scheme has reduced job losses in vulnerable firms, while loan schemes have supported over 20,000 firms in accessing loans.

sections.label: GIC and Temasek long-term performance
sections.summary: Both GIC and Temasek have performed creditably over longer and intermediate periods in a challenging investment environment.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: It has also been so over more intermediate periods, like a 10-year and five-year timeframe.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: So, I think if you look at the overall performance on the broader term, longer term, not just year-to-year, I think both GIC and Temasek have done creditably well in a very challenging investment environment.

sections.label: Green investments commercial basis
sections.summary: GIC and Temasek operate on a commercial basis, so their individual investment decisions are independent of the Government.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: On green investments, we have explained that both GIC and Temasek operate on a commercial basis, so their individual investment decisions are independent of the Government.

sections.label: Sustainability in GIC and Temasek investments
sections.summary: GIC and Temasek integrate sustainability considerations holistically across all asset classes to protect and enhance long-term investment value.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: GIC and Temasek integrate sustainability considerations holistically into their investment processes across all asset classes, so that they protect and enhance the long-term value of their investments.

sections.label: Draw on Past Reserves
sections.summary: A draw on Past Reserves occurs if revenues and surpluses accumulated during the current term cannot support current spending.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: A draw on Past Reserves occurs if our revenues and surpluses accumulated during the current term of Government are unable to support our current spending.

sections.label: Fiscal framework and cash sources
sections.summary: The fiscal framework has clear rules on what constitutes a draw on past reserves, but where the Government obtains cash for expenditures is separate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: I was talking about dealing with the issue of the execution of the spending of reserves.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, in terms of our fiscal framework, we have clear rules on what constitutes a draw on past reserves, but where the Government obtains the cash to pay for expenditures is a different matter.

sections.label: Funding fiscal year 2020 expenditures
sections.summary: To pay for expenditures in fiscal year 2020, the Government tapped all available sources of cash under the tool kits described.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: With regard to the specific question asked by Mr Leon Perera, to pay for expenditures in fiscal year 2020, the Government was able to tap on all available sources of cash under the tool kits which I just described.

sections.label: ABSD refund for married couples
sections.summary: Singaporean married couples may claim an ABSD refund on their second property if they sell their first within six months of purchase or TOP date.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Under this concession, we allow Singaporean married couples to claim a refund of the ABSD paid on their second property, provided they sell their first property within six months after the purchase of a completed property, or the Temporary Occupation Permit date of an uncompleted property.

sections.label: MOF fiscal system commitment
sections.summary: MOF is committed to a fiscal system that is fair, progressive, value-for-money and sustainable over the long term.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, MOF is committed to ensuring that our overall fiscal system is fair and progressive, achieves good value-for-money outcomes, and importantly, sustainable over the long term.

sections.label: Jamus Lim fiscal council cut
sections.summary: Assoc Prof Jamus Lim filed a gist proposing MOF consider an independent fiscal council or Parliamentary Budget Office seeded with $20 million.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The reason why that was referred to was because, when Members of Parliament file cuts, they have to give an indication of what the cut is about, so that the Ministry can prepare.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: And in this case, Assoc Prof Jamus Lim had filed his gist that he proposed that MOF consider the formation of an independent fiscal council or the Parliamentary Budget Office of Singapore, seeded with an initial $20 million.

sections.label: IFI setup after financial crisis
sections.summary: Independent fiscal institutions were set up worldwide mainly after the 2008 and 2009 Global Financial Crisis when deficits and debts were high.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The setting up of IFIs around the world took place mainly in the aftermath of the Global Financial Crisis in 2008 and 2009 where government deficits and debts were high.

sections.label: No IFI ills in Singapore
sections.summary: The ills that led to IFIs elsewhere are not present in Singapore's system, which keeps a strict eye on fiscal prudence.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: The ills which led to the need for IFIs in other systems are not present in our system and we continue to keep a very strict eye on our fiscal prudence.

sections.label: Fiscal council not substitute courage
sections.summary: Setting up an independent fiscal council will not substitute for such courage.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Setting up an independent fiscal council will not substitute for such courage.

sections.label: UK OBR forecast uncertainty
sections.summary: Forecasting is uncertain, and the UK's OBR has been criticised for overly optimistic forecasts and has downgraded them several times.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Forecasting is an inherently uncertain exercise, and independent institutions are not exempt from this uncertainty.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: So, the Office for Budget Responsibility, or OBR, in the UK has actually been criticised for overly optimistic forecasts and has had to downgrade its forecasts several times since it was set up.

sections.label: Energy efficiency grants and recycling
sections.summary: Businesses can tap EDB's REG(E) or NEA's E2F for energy-efficient technologies, while domestic recycling rate is hoped to reach 30% by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Businesses can tap on EDB's Resource Efficiency Grant for Energy (REG(E)) or NEA's Energy Efficiency Fund (E2F) for funding support to adopt energy-efficient technologies.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: However, there remain areas of improvement, such as our domestic recycling rate, which we hope to increase to 30% by 2030.

sections.label: JSS payouts brought forward
sections.summary: CPF Board and IRAS enhanced processes to speed up JSS disbursements, bringing payouts forward three months to April 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: For example, the CPF Board and the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (IRAS) enhanced their processes to speed up disbursements of the Jobs Support Scheme, or JSS.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: This enabled the JSS payouts to be brought forward by three months, from July 2020 to April 2020.

sections.label: Payment of small invoices
sections.summary: As of end January 2021, about 90% of invoices under $5,000 were paid within an average of 12 days, benefiting about 4,500 mostly SME businesses.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: As of end January 2021, about 90% of invoices less than $5,000 were paid within an average of 12 days, benefiting about 4,500 businesses, comprising mostly SMEs.

sections.label: MSF outreach and Budget feedback
sections.summary: MSF hired over 300 temporary staff in 2020 for the COVID-19 Support Grant and reached 50% more Singaporeans in Budget engagements, receiving close to 9,000 suggestions.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: For example, MSF hired more than 300 temporary staff in 2020, with many redeployed from the aviation sector, to ensure prompt accessing of the COVID-19 Support Grant.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Through a mix of traditional and digital media and engagement platforms, we reached out to 50% more Singaporeans during our recent Budget engagements, as compared to the previous year.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: We received suggestions from close to 9,000 Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: For example, we carefully evaluated feedback and included the coverage of qualifying shareholder-directors' wages under the JSS since May 2020.

sections.label: MOF grants governance framework
sections.summary: MOF established a new grants governance framework last year covering all grant stages from design to fraud detection.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: To strengthen grants management, MOF established a new grants governance framework last year that sets out rules and guidance that cover all stages of a grant – from grant design, approval and disbursement, to monitoring and fraud detection.

sections.label: Government Procurement Function Office
sections.summary: MOF set up the Government Procurement Function Office last year to transform and strengthen the Government's procurement function.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: MOF set up the Government Procurement Function Office last year to drive efforts to transform and strengthen the Government's procurement function.

sections.label: Consolidated facilities management savings
sections.summary: Consolidating facilities management of The Treasury and Revenue House has resulted in estimated annual savings of $1.2 million.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: As a start, we have consolidated the facilities management of The Treasury and Revenue House.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: This has resulted in estimated annual savings of $1.2 million.

sections.label: MOF GovTech digital purchases partnership
sections.summary: MOF and GovTech are partnering businesses to co-create a solution for public officers making smaller value purchases on commercial digital platforms.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: For instance, MOF and GovTech are partnering businesses to co-create a solution which facilitates public officers to make smaller value purchases on commercial digital platforms.

sections.label: Emergency Procurement provisions
sections.summary: Emergency Procurement provisions let agencies buy services more promptly, and were used last year during the crisis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: I think some Members had asked questions about the processes in which these procurements could be done quickly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: I had explained then that we do have Emergency Procurement provisions in place where for such cases, there are provisions for agencies to make use of these Emergency Procurement provisions in order to buy services more promptly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: And indeed, these were made use of last year during the crisis and when we had, in particular, to respond very quickly.

sections.label: Macro-economic and fiscal environment
sections.summary: A Member agrees with a point but asks whether the Minister suggests today's macro-economic and fiscal environment is as unchanged as historically.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: And I would put on the record that I agree that this, in fact, is the case.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: That said, I wonder first if the Minister is also suggesting that our macro-economic and fiscal environment today is as unchanged as it has been historically, and even in the midst of the largest reserve drawdown in our history?

sections.label: Independent fiscal council proposal
sections.summary: The suggestion was that an independent fiscal council would serve the full Parliament, letting all Members request scoring of policy proposals.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: So, my suggestion in the cut was that the independent fiscal council, the Parliamentary Budget Office, whatever we wish to call it, would serve the full Parliament.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: So, all Members of this House would be able to pose requests for scoring of policy proposals that are advanced.

sections.label: Global pandemic crisis century
sections.summary: The world has seen the biggest crisis in a century, when the last global pandemic was around.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The world has seen the biggest crisis in a century, which was when the last global pandemic was around.

sections.label: Past growth and deficit forecasts
sections.summary: The last government's growth forecasts over 10 years were out by £13 billion on average, and deficit forecasts three years ahead by £40 billion.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The last government's forecast for growth in the economy over the past 10 years have, on average, been out by £13 billion.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Their forecasts of the budget deficit three years ahead have on average been out by £40 billion.

sections.label: Request for fiscal council
sections.summary: The learned Member is asking for a $20 million fiscal council to assist Opposition Members with their proposals.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, in essence, what the learned Member is actually asking is for this council to serve the Opposition Members because the PAP Members are not asking for this, and the Government does not need it.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, effectively, it is a request for a $20 million fiscal council to assist the Opposition Members with their proposals.

sections.label: Research translation to economic output
sections.summary: The translation from research to economic output and whether local companies benefit is something the Government tracks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: On the first question, the translation from research to economic output, and whether or not local companies themselves are benefiting from this, this is indeed something we do track.

sections.label: Nanofilm recent listing
sections.summary: Members would have read about Nanofilm that was listed recently.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Members would have read about Nanofilm that was listed recently.

sections.label: Temasek and GIC performance review
sections.summary: The Government continually reviews the evaluation performance of both Temasek and GIC.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Second, on evaluation performance of both Temasek and GIC, the Government continually reviews the performances of these two entities.

sections.label: Rolling returns over longer periods
sections.summary: Returns are assessed on an overall, longer-term basis, preferably over 20 years, with intermediate 10 and five-year milestones.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We look at it on an overall basis and over a longer term.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: It is really rolling returns over a longer period of time, preferably over 20 years, which we do, but then we have intermediate milestones and we look at 10 and five-year periods as well.

sections.label: Several Budgets in 12 months
sections.summary: The passage states that there have been quite a series of Budgets in the last 12 months.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa
sentences.text: In the last 12 months, we have quite a series of Budgets.

sections.label: Thanks for fiscal response
sections.summary: A Member thanks Minister Lawrence Wong, Minister Indranee and the Deputy Prime Minister for the Government's fiscal response and hopes for a one-Budget financial year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa
sentences.text: I want to also thank Minister Lawrence Wong and Minister Indranee for responding to our cuts; and, finally, to the Deputy Prime Minister, really thank him for the solid and steady steer of the Government's fiscal response during these very difficult circumstances, challenging circumstances we are in, and getting us into the safe zone.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa
sentences.text: I certainly share the Deputy Prime Minister's wish and hope that this FY will be a one-Budget FY, and that we will soon get back to a balanced Budget in the next few years.
